post_title: My research paper got selected and its burdening me
parent_text:
What is IIM smoking? 

It's insane to charge 7k for a student participation. First, write to IIM asking for a travel grant if possible. You'll still be reimbursed for train travel most probably. Also, talk to your hod,and  dean research in your institute. Tell them you're presenting in a prestigious institution and request monetary assistance. It's not about affording it, but it's your right as a student. Even faculty ask for travel grants all the time. It ENABLES research and is pretty much a norm. Your institute should encourage this. 

Second, presentations can be done by one author as well. So if you're friend is so willing just ask her to travel and present. Make sure you're given credit for the work you've done on the paper.

Third, be proud of getting selected and stop whining about how you can't afford it. You're still a graduate student and you've done an incredible job. You're building a life for yourself and not inheriting one from your parents.

parent_text: Should I get a job after doing my bba? Or complete my MBA and then get a job?
original_text:
Okay that really depends on what you want to do in your life and what field you want to pursue.

Hard reality is that after your BBA, you won’t get many job offers. Most of them will either be in early age start-ups or through family connections or if you want to start your own company. I got a 10-12 LPA job offer after my BBA. I didn’t take it but I also didn’t search a lot, this one came on its own.

Here is some food for thought though:

1) I know a few IPMers who did MBA and then started their corporate journey, made a bank and repaid their loans and ROI after 4 years and then went abroad for one more degree. 

2) There are few IPMers who left after BBA for a job/startup/own gig. Few of them are really doing well. They have become VCs, UPSC grads etc

3) There are a couple of IPMers who came back to college after 1-2 years of work ex.

Honestly if MBA is your eventual goal, the UG degree on its own won’t give you a strong place in corporate specially in slightly bigger orgs. So that is my take but again totally depends on what you want to do in life.

College has an option for sabbatical though

post_title: What should i choose?? (CAT 2027)
parent_text:
Your profile shouldn’t decide online vs offline; your learning routine should. Since you have time and access to CP, 2 offline demos and 2 live-online demos lo. Compare the actual faculty, batch size, doubt support, recordings, commute and whether you can revise the same day. Sirf brand presentation dekh ke long course mat buy karna. If travel leaves no revision time, online may be more sustainable; if you procrastinate at home and need a fixed schedule, offline may suit you better.  
  
BLACKI/FMS isn’t ruled out, but abhi a “safe” percentile or conversion predict karna honest nahi hoga. Each school and cycle weights academics, category and CAT differently; SC status isn’t a guarantee. A 6–6.5 CGPA can hurt where graduation marks carry weight, so push it up while you still can.  
  
Internships and societies ko checkbox ki tarah chase mat karo. One meaningful internship, project or responsibility is better than random certificates. Abhi CGPA plus CAT fundamentals pe focus karo, then verify official criteria in your application year.
